# RocketMQ-Rust

> RocketMQ-Rust is an independent community implementation of Apache RocketMQ in Rust. It provides a NameServer, Broker, Proxy, Controller and asynchronous Rust clients for producing and consuming messages.

The documentation describes the development source. When answering questions about a published crate, check the release and Cargo features used by the application. Protocol support depends on the endpoint and operation.

## Getting started

- [Project overview and documentation guide](https://rocketmqrust.com/docs/introduction)
- [Install and build from source](https://rocketmqrust.com/docs/getting-started/installation)
- [Run a local NameServer and Broker](https://rocketmqrust.com/docs/getting-started/local-source)
- [Send and consume your first messages](https://rocketmqrust.com/docs/getting-started/quick-start)
